name: Wisp Guard
description: Hold the thin early wisp of soul tight against the mind so a pressing thought slides off.

name: Faint Veil
description: Draw a pale veil over the thoughts to turn a prying touch aside before it settles.

name: Wisp Breath
description: Breathe slowly and feel through the wisp for any crack or chill that a soul blow has left.

name: Tender Hold
description: Cup the bruised wisp in patient attention until the small hurt of the self knits closed.

name: Steady Spark
description: Feed the wisp one patient pulse so that it holds its shape through a hard moment.

name: Ward Draw
description: Draw the soul in round the self as a plain ward that blunts a hostile push of will.

name: Mind Hold
description: Plant the thoughts firmly so that a pressing will finds nothing loose to pull at.

name: Slant Veil
description: Tilt the ward at a slant so that an incoming soul strike slides past the self.

name: Bell Check
description: Tap the soul gently and listen for the faint ring that tells whether the ward is sound.

name: Shell Mend
description: Press attention on a thin place in the ward until the soul fibres draw together again.

name: Calm Stance
description: Steady the breath and set the soul square so that the ward bears a harder push.

name: Calm Shell
description: Settle into a deep calm and let the soul harden round the mind like a shell.

name: Level Ward
description: Keep the ward level and smooth so that soul force skims across it and away.

name: Hush Shift
description: Move the soul's centre half a pace aside so that a seeking touch lands on empty air.

name: Gentle Probe
description: Send out a light thread of soul to feel where an unseen mind is leaning in.

name: Settle Draw
description: Draw frayed thoughts back to a single point to ease the strain of a shaken mind.

name: Forehead Plate
description: Lay a flat plate of firm will over the forehead of the soul to take a sharp soul jab.

name: Turning Thought
description: Turn the mind to a new thought at the moment of impact so that the blow lands wide.

name: Calm Heartbeat
description: Keep the soul pulse even and unhurried so that fear and force have no rhythm to grip.

name: Patient Ear
description: Listen for the pull of a hostile will on the edges of the self and mark where it comes from.

name: Rested Mind
description: Let the soul lie quiet for a long breath so that weariness of the mind drains away.

name: Firm Resolve
description: Gather will into one firm point so that an ally's wavering spirit stands up again.

name: Shell Press
description: Press the soul shell tight against the mind at the instant a hostile force arrives.

name: Smooth Glance
description: Make the shell smooth as glass so that a soul strike glances off at an angle.

name: Still Lantern
description: Hold the soul still as a lantern flame and watch how nearby minds make it flicker.

name: Seam Knit
description: Pull the edges of a split in the shell together and hold them until they join.

name: Tally Brace
description: Count three slow beats and let each one thicken the shell a little more.

name: Mirrorgloss
description: Give the surface of the soul a bright polish that throws a hostile glance back at its source.

name: Veil Hang
description: Hang a loose veil of will about the mind and let it drift with every push.

name: Sheen Turn
description: Rotate the polished veil a quarter turn so that a glancing blow slips off its edge.

name: Glint Sense
description: Watch for a glint on the veil that shows where a soul probe has touched it.

name: Veil Dust
description: Brush a faint charge of soul force off the veil before it can gather into a hurt.

name: Polish Mend
description: Rub a scratched patch of the veil smooth with slow attention until it shines again.

name: Bright Hold
description: Share the veil's polish with an ally's mind so that both turn back the same push.

name: Hush Shell
description: Go perfectly silent inside so that a probing soul finds no surface to grip.

name: Mute Step
description: Slide the soul's presence a short way from where it was a heartbeat before.

name: Quiet Listen
description: Keep still and let the silence carry the touch of any soul that draws near.

name: Quiet Homecoming
description: Bring a shaken ally back to quiet by laying a calm presence beside the frightened mind.

name: Stillness Gift
description: Pass a measure of stillness to an ally so that a hostile will cannot rattle them.

name: Pinned Thought
description: Tie every thought to one fixed point so that a hostile will cannot move the mind.

name: Anchor Slip
description: Let the anchored thought hold firm while the surface of the mind lets the blow slip by.

name: Plumb Cord
description: Cast a taut line of will from the anchor so that the mind is not dragged off course.

name: Drift Gauge
description: Gauge how far the anchor has been pulled and how hard the unseen pull is.

name: Anchor Rest
description: Lay the mind back on its anchor to soothe the ache that a long soul contest leaves.

name: Anchor Gift
description: Lend the weight of the anchor to an ally so that their thoughts stop drifting.
